scope: Only explicit logicalRegionName is implemented, equal and AND-bound to both VOLUME and STORAGE_POOL requests and SQL. No implicit region. Global/missing-region, AZ/tenant/VDC-name-filtered variants remain unsupported; this is not an arbitrary ranking DSL.
population: Observed VDC IDs owning at least one volume in the requested logical region. No VDC directory is fetched, so a no-volume response cannot prove that all VDCs have zero capacity.
identity: logicalRegionName+vdcId, not vdcName. Fixed whitespace-only unknown IDs normalize to NULL on fresh schema-projected copies. Nonblank IDs preserve exact whitespace and are never guessed from names. Distinct display names yieldNULL label; identity remains the ID.
ranking: Normalize each valid nonnegative raw size into exact integer units at scale1e6. SUM every volume ID independently before any pool join; no TEXT ordering, dirty CAST or SUM(DISTINCT size). Select every equal maximum with explicit all_ties. Decimal0.1+0.2 ties0.3 exactly.
size_parsing: Source raw unit is preserved and not asserted to be GB/GiB. Bounded lexical grammar: ASCII digits with optional decimal point and1..6 fractional digits, after fixed-edge whitespace removal; no signs/exponents/units/commas/rounding. NULL/blank/dirty/too-fine precision are unknown, not zero. Per-value and sum scaled magnitude must fit signed64-bit; overflow is explicitly blocked.
unknown_policies: unknown_owner_policy and unknown_size_policy are both required. reject stops. known_only retains excluded/unknown counts in final diagnostics, reports only known-capacity lower-bound leaders, sets scope_max_certified=false and full_answer_certified=false whenever any unknown could change a winner. Complete owner total isNULL if its size is incomplete or any owner ID in scope is unknown.
pool_link: VOLUME.attachBackendId=STORAGE_POOL.id and same logicalRegionName. Only after choosing VDC leaders, expand DISTINCT referenced backend IDs; retain no_pool_reference parent rows and unresolved_pool references, with unknown/unresolved volume counts. Many volumes/pools do not multiply capacity.
pool_role: Generic volume storage pools, not database-dedicated disks or pools. Shared pool details are whole-pool capacity fields, never a claim of exclusive VDC allocation. Same pool may appear once for each tied VDC.
grain: one observed winning regionalVDC ID x distinct referenced pool ID, or one placeholder detail row retaining a winner with no pool reference
NULL_and_empty: Only VOLUME.vdcName may be omitted at row level when actual source schema declares it. A fresh local row copy supplies NULL for that field only. Every other source key remains required; present NULL/blank display semantics stay unchanged. Failed/unknown/schema-missing/placeholder data never becomes zero.
